counterfactual_missing_items: no mention of other tumor types with similar histologic features
no evidence of other diseases that could cause similar symptoms
decisive_items: dense, perivascular spindle cell proliferation with prominent cytological atypia, frequent mitoses, and an infiltrative growth pattern
The tumor was in close contact with peripheral nerves
tumor cells were positive for S100, p16, neurofilaments, and CD56
response.rationale: The combination of histologic features, tumor location, and immunohistochemical results strongly supports the diagnosis of Malignant Peripheral Nerve Sheath Tumor (MPNST).
